caseNameFull: Thompson, Trustee v. Magnolia Petroleum Co.
attorneys: Mr. Thos. T, Raüey for petitioner. Messrs. Craig Van Meter and Fred H. Kelly for respondents.

opinions.text: The petition for rehearing is granted. The order denying certiorari ante, p. 613; is vacated and the petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit is granted.
